selection_basis: fixed pre-registration before coverage/performance; cross-sector fresh universe; must be absent from trial ledger and registered asset-universe catalogue; no performance-based replacement

E1_ALPHA_COMMON_MODE_THROTTLE.correlation: mean pairwise Pearson correlation across the six sleeve return streams
E1_ALPHA_COMMON_MODE_THROTTLE.timing: decision at close t uses only sleeve holding-period returns whose endpoints are fully known before close t

E2_TURNOVER_HYSTERESIS.carry_forward: retain previous nonzero weight when nonzero-to-nonzero target change is below threshold
E2_TURNOVER_HYSTERESIS.entry_exit_override: zero-to-nonzero and nonzero-to-zero changes execute immediately
E2_TURNOVER_HYSTERESIS.timing: apply after fixed target weights are generated and before the next holding-period return

required_sequence: only after both pass: separate fixed-rule performance evaluation of E1 and E2 under unchanged 13-gate contract
